preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= len(S) for S, K in zip(S_list, K_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, K is between 1 and the length of S.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= char <= 'z' for char in S) for S in S_list)
preconditions.description: Each character in S is a lowercase English alphabet letter.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(subseq) == K for subseq, K in zip(output_list, K_list))
postconditions.description: Each output subsequence has length K.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join(sorted(subseq)) == subseq for subseq in output_list)
postconditions.description: Each output subsequence is lexicographically smallest among all possible subsequences of length K.
